# fflate 0.8.2

Unmodified browser UMD bundle, used to create tutorial submission ZIPs locally.

- Upstream: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate/tree/v0.8.2
- Bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/fflate@0.8.2/umd/index.js
- License: MIT, included in `LICENSE`
- Bundle SHA-256: `c3b34f2e9f5e74d4d7d64e01cac7a0c01954c6c406414d42185c7b53d6875ddf`

Loaded only on tutorials that opt into `download`. No CDN request is needed to
create the archive, and no student content is sent to a server.
